workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain candidate census tract polygons covering the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Search the available catalog for census tract polygon data covering the State College borough area. Return a GeoPackage candidate suitable for polygon overlay; runtime inspection must verify its analytical fitness.

workflow_steps.title: Repair borough boundary geometry
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce a valid geometry for the supplied State College borough boundary before binary overlay.
workflow_steps.instructions: Explicitly repair invalid geometries in the supplied boundary layer and preserve its spatial meaning and GeoPackage representation.

workflow_steps.title: Intersect borough boundary with census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Create the tract portions that overlap the repaired State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a polygon intersection overlay between the repaired boundary and the retrieved census tract layer. Use the runtime-verified tract candidate and preserve relevant attributes from both inputs.
